1.text: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

2.text: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

3.text: And when the mountains are removed

4.text: And when full-term she-camels<sup foot_note="228186">1</sup> are neglected

footnotes.228186: - Those ten months pregnant and nearing delivery. This verse alludes to distraction from the most valued of possessions.

5.text: And when the wild beasts are gathered

6.text: And when the seas are filled with flame<sup foot_note="228187">1</sup>

footnotes.228187: - Or "when the seas have overflowed [into each other]."

7.text: And when the souls are paired<sup foot_note="228188">1</sup>

footnotes.228188: - With another like soul. It can also mean "joined" (with their groups or sects) .

8.text: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

9.text: For what sin she was killed

10.text: And when the pages<sup foot_note="228189">1</sup> are spread [i.e., made public]

footnotes.228189: - On which are recorded the deeds of all people.

11.text: And when the sky is stripped away

12.text: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

13.text: And when Paradise is brought near,

14.text: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].<sup foot_note="228190">1</sup>

footnotes.228190: - i.e., all of one's deeds from worldly life, which have accompanied the soul to the Hereafter.

15.text: So I swear by the retreating stars -

16.text: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

17.text: And by the night as it closes in<sup foot_note="228191">1</sup>

footnotes.228191: - An alternative meaning is "as it departs."

18.text: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

19.text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

20.text: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

21.text: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

22.text: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.<sup foot_note="228192">1</sup>

23.text: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.<sup foot_note="228193">1</sup>

footnotes.228193: - i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote to 53:6.

24.text: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.<sup foot_note="228194">1</sup>

footnotes.228194: - Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) did not withhold that knowledge of the unseen which Allāh had revealed to him in the Qur’ān.

25.text: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

26.text: So where are you going?<sup foot_note="228195">1</sup>

footnotes.228195: - In your denial of the Qur’ān and in your accusations against the Prophet (ﷺ) . The meaning is essentially "Surely, you have strayed far from Allāh's path."

27.text: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

28.text: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

29.text: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
